summary: stomping missives of misery laundered on pains of painted hands clocks turning time and time again Not Forgotten they fester as nightmares in light for little ones who lack the luxury to forget #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
stomping
   missives of
misery
laundered on
pains of
painted hands
clocks
turning
   time
and
   time
again
Not
   Forgotten
they fester
  as nightmares in
light for
   little ones
who lack the luxury
  to forget
#smallpoems
